qa_audit.doable_note: All steps connector-doable. 13 tools = image_* photo/raster grade + crop_and_resize export + asset upload/finalize + create_firefly_board, all headless-confirmed [C]. No banned capability: no generative expand/fill, no text-to-image, no upscale, no object-removal reconstruction, no perspective/vertical warp. Selective single-color saturation + gentle vibrance (not global pump). Spec explicitly flags converging-vertical warp and cable/stain cloning as OUT of connector scope and hands them to the human finisher rather than faking them.
qa_audit.presentation_note: Well-formed: one deliverable set, full_brief with ordered requirements, inputs with realism_notes, outputs with specs, coherent output-to-input chain, reverify present. Weakness (already self-flagged in reverify, severity minor): the pool and terrace upload steps are folded into the prose of steps 1-2 rather than enumerated, so steps 9 (pool_assetURI) and 14 (terrace_assetURI) consume raw asset URIs not produced by any numbered step, and tool_call_count=19 under-counts by 4 real upload calls (each of the two extra assets needs its own initialize+finalize). Every actual op is a valid [C] tool; this is an enumeration/accounting nit, not a correctness or doability problem.
qa_audit.top_issue: Pool/terrace upload steps are described in prose instead of being enumerated, so steps 9/14 consume un-numbered raw asset URIs and tool_call_count (19) under-counts the true call total by ~4 upload calls — an enumeration nit, not a real defect.
